chain.step: POINTS: carbon fleet + Marolinta = managed fleet
POINTS: the fleet is the successfully rehabilitated plus those never rehabilitated

chain.detail: 6 never rehabilitated = 5 Marolinta (works on the borehole form) + 1 recorded + 0 unexplained
chain.step: POINTS: every fleet point with no successful rehabilitation is accounted for

gaps.step: managed fleet is a subset of the register
gaps.what: 1 managed point(s) are not in the register export: 742896839

calendar_evidenced_2026.decided: The gardien calendar is the official record of days operational.
calendar_evidenced_2026.name: 2026 calendar-evidenced points
calendar_evidenced_2026.rule: Carbon-fleet points with a readable gardien calendar sheet dated 2026, the year read off the sheet itself. This is what the days-operational evidence rests on.

carbon_fleet.decided: Marolinta is Deichmann-funded and enters no carbon figure, so it cannot be in a carbon denominator.
carbon_fleet.name: Carbon fleet
reads: as managed_fleet, less the Marolinta site
carbon_fleet.rule: The managed fleet less Marolinta. This is the denominator under every carbon figure on the page.

down_now.decided: Status is the last thing anyone recorded about a pump.
down_now.name: Points down now
down_now.rule: Managed points whose most recent record - call, maintenance visit or repair - says the pump is not working.

first_rehabilitated.decided: A first rehabilitation is what puts a point into the programme. The record is the evidence it happened.
first_rehabilitated.name: First-rehabilitated points
reads: Clean Water || Première réhabilitation / Entretien préventif / Réparation après panne
the live successor - zero responses today, read so the first one does not arrive unnoticed
Clean Water || Suivi avancement nouveau forage et réhabilitation
the Marolinta works, which are recorded only here
first_rehabilitated.rule: Water points with a first-rehabilitation record on the works form, whatever the outcome. One point can carry more than one such record; the point is counted once.

first_rehabilitation_records.decided: A record is the evidence the work happened; a point is the thing worked on. They are counted separately because they are different questions.
first_rehabilitation_records.name: First-rehabilitation records
reads: Clean Water || Première réhabilitation / Entretien préventif / Réparation après panne
first_rehabilitation_records.rule: Every first-rehabilitation RECORD on the works form. This counts records, not water points: it is the number of times the work was written down. On the current data each record is on a different point, so the two happen to be equal - that is a fact about today, not a rule.

hygiene_session_points.decided: Kept as a population so the training form is read by something and a migration onto it cannot pass unnoticed.
hygiene_session_points.name: Hygiene-session points
reads: Clean Water || Formation et Suivi promotion de l'hygiène
every response with a linked water point
hygiene_session_points.rule: Water points with a hygiene-promotion session recorded on the live training form. Not a carbon figure; it is where the field photographs on this page come from.

identified_points.decided: The identification survey is what puts a point on the map at all.
identified_points.name: Identified points
reads: Clean Water || Identification des points d'eau
every response with a linked water point
identified_points.rule: Water points with an identification survey on the live identification form - the first visit, before any works.

located_register_points.decided: The distances in the corrections log were hand-measured with no stated set. Declaring the set makes them derivable.
located_register_points.name: Located register points
located_register_points.rule: Register records carrying a coordinate in mWater. This is the set every “nearest other point” distance is measured against: the whole register, not the managed fleet, because the nearest point to a dormant one is often a working point and sometimes another dormant one.

managed_fleet.decided: Adriaan Mol, COO SaniTap - the standing reconciliation recorded in data/register_corrections.json
managed_fleet.name: Managed fleet
reads: the register, reconciled against the works and call forms by the weekly build
managed_fleet.rule: The water points MadAvance actively maintains today - the fleet this report is about. Every one has a maintenance history: it is visited, repaired and called about. This is the population behind “water points in scope”.

marolinta.decided: Marolinta is funded separately and is not in the VPA.
marolinta.name: Marolinta
reads: Clean Water || Suivi avancement nouveau forage et réhabilitation
the Marolinta deployment of that form
marolinta.rule: The Marolinta boreholes. Deichmann-funded, and outside the carbon programme entirely - they enter no carbon figure.

marolinta_works_records.decided: Marolinta works were put on their own form because the works form has no “Nouvelle construction” option.
marolinta_works_records.name: Marolinta works records
reads: Clean Water || Suivi avancement nouveau forage et réhabilitation
marolinta_works_records.rule: Every works record on the Marolinta borehole-progress form - rehabilitations and new constructions both. These never appear on the works form, so a query that reads only that form cannot see Marolinta at all.

register_records.decided: The group is the boundary of what MadAvance holds. Not a decision so much as a fact about the account.
register_records.name: Register records
register_records.rule: Every water-point record in the MadAvance group in mWater. This is everything MadAvance holds, most of which we do not maintain: surveys, points handed on, rope pumps, abandoned points.

rehabilitated_successfully.decided: A rehabilitation that did not succeed does not put a point into the maintained fleet.
rehabilitated_successfully.name: Successfully rehabilitated points
reads: question "Vérifier : La réparation ou la maintenance a réussi ?" = Oui
Clean Water || Suivi avancement nouveau forage et réhabilitation
the Marolinta works, which are recorded only here
rehabilitated_successfully.rule: Of the first-rehabilitated points, those whose record answers Yes to “Verify: did the repair or maintenance succeed?”. A point with any successful first-rehabilitation record counts as successful.

repairs_since_aug_2024.decided: 628 could not be reproduced from anything held, so the rule was written down and the number allowed to follow it. Withdrawal logged as repairs_628.
repairs_since_aug_2024.name: Repairs since 1 August 2024
repairs_since_aug_2024.rule: Every repair-after-breakdown record on either repair source - the retired combined form and its live successor - that is linked to a water point and was submitted on or after 1 August 2024, counted once per point and date. The de-duplication is not cosmetic: three (point, date) pairs carry two records each, one of which spans the migration boundary and is a genuine double entry.

repairs_time_measured.decided: The stored ttr_n of 606 reproduces from no rule; the measurable set is 617. The median of 1.0 days and mean of 3.6 days are unchanged by the correction.
repairs_time_measured.name: Repairs with a measured time out of service
reads: dates "Date de notification de la panne" and "Date d’achèvement des travaux"
dates "Date de notification de la panne" and "Date fin des travaux"
repairs_time_measured.rule: Repairs since 1 August 2024 that carry BOTH a breakdown notification date and a works completion date, and whose completion is not before its notification. Only these can be timed, so only these are in the median and the mean.

successful_first_rehabilitation_records.decided: Withdrawn figure 723 could not be reproduced from any data held; the records give 731. See the decision log.
successful_first_rehabilitation_records.name: Successful first-rehabilitation records
reads: question "Vérifier : La réparation ou la maintenance a réussi ?" = Oui
successful_first_rehabilitation_records.rule: Of those records, the ones answering Yes to “Verify: did the repair or maintenance succeed?”. Still a count of records.

water_quality_tested.decided: SDWS 3 needs a result per point; the result form is the record.
water_quality_tested.name: Water-quality tested points
reads: Clean Water || Water Quality Testing SDWS 3 Result
every response with a linked water point
Clean Water || Water Quality Sampling SDWS 3
the sampling half of the same process
water_quality_tested.rule: Water points with a result on the SDWS 3 water-quality results form. Read from the LIVE results form, not from the retired combined form's water-analysis branch - that branch stopped taking records in July 2025 and a population reading it would have frozen there.
